policy: Separate original-label, exploratory tree-budget study. Root MLP width 4 and 120 training epochs remain fixed while correction networks supply additional capacity. Hybrid CNNs are independently trained only at depth 1. No shared trained trunk, pretrained weights, augmentation or added label noise. Unrestricted parameter-matched MLP and CNN-only controls test whether the tree provides value beyond extra capacity. Both validation-preserving and training-fit-preserving pruning are reported. Preserve Version 1 and broader-root Version 2 trials. Improvement and double descent are hypotheses, not required outcomes.
